standard_prerequisites.name: The explicit description of the derived sections with support in the closed subset of a finitely generated ideal by the Cech type complex on the generators
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 705-706) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows directly that the number of generators bounds the cohomological dimension.

standard_prerequisites.name: The independence of the derived sections with support of the chosen finitely generated ideal defining the closed subset, together with the vanishing of the cohomology of a quasi-coherent sheaf on a space covered by a bounded number of affines
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 707-715 and 716-718) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: The first transfers the bound from one set of generators to any other, the second converts an affine covering bound into a vanishing bound.

core_obligations: Bound by the number of generators: the explicit description of the derived sections with support as the Cech type complex on a set of generators gives the first bound immediately (proof lines 705-707)

Transfer to any defining set: using that the derived sections with support depend only on the closed subset and not on the chosen finitely generated ideal defining it, the first bound applies to the r given elements and gives the second bound (proof lines 707-715)

Bound by an affine covering: the characterisation of cohomological dimension through the vanishing of the cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on the complement, together with the vanishing on a complement covered by c affines, gives the third bound (proof lines 716-718)
proof_roadmap: (1) 由 RΓ_Y(-) 在生成元上的 Čech 型复形描述立得。(2) 由 RΓ_Z 只依赖闭子集 Z、不依赖定义 Z 的有限生成理想这一事实，把 (1) 用到 f_1,…,f_r 上。
(3) 用 cd 的等价刻画（补集上拟凝聚层的高阶上同调消没）与「补集可被 c 个仿射开集覆盖」的消没结果（跨章引理）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects three upper bounds for the cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal: by the number of generators, by any family of r elements defining the same closed subset, and by the number of affines needed to cover the complement (author lemma at source lines 690-702, label lemma-bound-cd). The proof (source lines 704-719) reads the first bound off the explicit Cech type description of the derived sections with support, transfers it to any other defining family using the independence of the construction from the chosen ideal, and obtains the third bound from the standard characterisation of cohomological dimension together with the vanishing of the cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves on a union of c affines. The transfer step (2) is the only part with an argument of its own; parts (1) and (3) are direct from the cited descriptions. H2.
